step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identified core services from whiteboard and transcript: Aurora, DMS, Internet (ThirdParty), Lambda, Glue, Lake Formation, S3, Step Functions, Terraform (ThirdParty), Data Marketplace (ThirdParty), API Gateway.
2. Ingestion pipeline 1: Internet data ingested by Lambda, which writes into S3.
3. Ingestion pipeline 2: DMS accesses MySQL Aurora binlog files and continuously streams data to S3.
4. Catalog & Governance: Glue accesses S3 to create metadata catalog and perform ETL. Lake Formation manages fine-grained permissions over Glue catalog. Data Marketplace integrates with Lake Formation for access control.
5. Orchestration & Platform Integration: API Gateway triggers Step Functions.
6. IaC: Infrastructure and dataset descriptors are managed by Terraform provisioning resources in S3.

graph.name: TIS Cloud Data Lake Architecture
graph.notes: Data lake architecture managing over 15TB of data growing at ~500GB/month. Implements multi-account setup with data isolation, fine-grained access control via Lake Formation, and IaC data product management with Terraform.

nodes.name: AURORA
nodes.notes: MySQL Aurora database serving as a primary operational data source.

nodes.name: DMS
nodes.notes: Database Migration Service reading binlogs from Aurora for continuous ingestion.

nodes.name: LAMBDA
nodes.notes: Triggered serverless ingestion functions that write data to S3.

nodes.name: GLUE
nodes.notes: Creates metadata catalog and executes Glue Workflows/ETL processes.

nodes.name: LAKE FORMATION
nodes.notes: Provides fine-grained permission control and security tag management over Glue catalog.

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Central Data Lake storage holding ~15TB of data, separated by security categories.

nodes.name: STEPFUNCTIONS
nodes.notes: Orchestrates complex data workflows and integration steps.

nodes.name: TF
nodes.notes: Terraform used to provision infrastructure and consistent dataset descriptors.

nodes.name: Data MP
nodes.notes: Internal Data Marketplace for analysts and data scientists to explore compliant data products.

nodes.name: API GATEWAY
nodes.notes: Integrates internal platform services with data lake capabilities.

edges.notes: Lambda writes ingested data into S3 buckets.
DMS connects to Aurora to read binlogs.
DMS continuously writes migration files into S3.
Glue accesses data in S3 for cataloging and ETL processing.
Lake Formation enforces fine-grained access policies on Glue catalog.
Data Marketplace queries metadata and access policies via Lake Formation.
API Gateway routes requests to Step Functions.
Terraform provisions data lake S3 resources and dataset descriptors.
